$comment: LL Flooring runs Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFRA, Sites-llflooring-Site) behind Cloudflare; the product page is server-rendered, although many links and image paths are written relative ('/../../media-sub/...', which resolves and serves the image). Product URLs are /p/<slug>-<item number>/ (slugs may contain dots, for example 6.81-in.-wide). Prices are in US dollars and returned in cents with currency USD. The page shows two prices in one block: the per-square-foot price ($2.19 / Sq Ft, also the JSON-LD offer price) and the per-box price ($51.75 / box, covers 23.63 Sq Ft) that the cart sells; no element holds the per-sq-ft figure alone, so price_current reads the hidden div#product-content, which carries only the box price, and price_area keeps both figures in price.raw. No sale or out-of-stock page was found to base price_regular or availability.out_of_stock on, so an unorderable product is detected only by the missing Add to Cart button. The description is the paragraphs of the first product-copy block (the bullet list and the buying-guide link are left out). Specs come from the Specifications tab: titled spec-section groups (Details, Dimensions, ..., Warranties & Certifications) of li rows; the hidden 'What is ...?' tooltip in each name is excluded. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with every field and 40 specs; browser: same data, slower; duckduckgo: partial (title and snippet); mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: BOT_PROTECTION (no tokens); ai-crawler-cloudflare: not configured. http is selected: full data at the lowest cost. Checked against a saved (curl) CoreLuxe 5mm w/pad Daydream Meadow Oak page on 2026-11-19.
